title: Tag 变动范围（Drop/Shuffle 作用域）

standard.summary: 控制 tag dropout 与 caption shuffle 作用在整段还是仅分隔符后半段。默认 all 保持旧行为。
standard.effect: all：整段 tag 都可随机丢/打乱。after_separator：仅 caption_tag_scope_separator（默认 |||）之后的 tag 可 drop/shuffle，前半段（触发词+构图结构）始终保留。
standard.whenToUse: 标注写成「触发词, 构图, 动作, ||| 特征词, 服装词」且希望 drop/shuffle 只动后半段时，设 after_separator。
standard.avoidWhen: 没有固定前缀需要保护、或标注里没有稳定分隔符时保持 all。

standard_en.summary: Sets whether tag dropout and caption shuffle act on the whole caption or only the part after the separator. The default all keeps the old behaviour.
standard_en.effect: all: every tag can be dropped or shuffled. after_separator: only tags after caption_tag_scope_separator (||| by default) can be dropped or shuffled, so the first part (trigger word plus compositional structure) is always kept.
standard_en.whenToUse: Set after_separator when captions read like "trigger, composition, action, ||| feature words, clothing words" and you want dropping and shuffling confined to the second half.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Keep all when there is no fixed prefix to protect, or when the captions have no reliable separator.

advanced.principle: 字符串级 split(sep,1) 切 head/tail；uniform drop + shuffle 只打 tail；keep_tokens 在 after_separator 下只作用于 tail 前缀。keep_tokens_separator 仍是输出插入符，不负责解析保护区。无分隔符时 after_separator 退化为 all。
advanced.intervention: CaptionDataset._process_caption → _process_caption_scoped；Anima 缓存路径仅对齐 shuffle 作用域（无 runtime tag dropout）。
advanced.expectedImpact: 触发词与构图前缀稳定，特征/服装类 tag 仍可做正则增强。
advanced.tradeoffs: 定向 tag dropout 仍扫全列表；整句 caption_dropout 仍可清空整句。Anima multi_copy 只产生顺序变体，不在缓存路径补完整 tag dropout 栈。

advanced_en.principle: String-level split(sep,1) cuts head/tail; uniform drop + shuffle act only on the tail; keep_tokens under after_separator applies only to the tail prefix. keep_tokens_separator remains the output joiner and is not responsible for parsing the protected zone. Without a separator, after_separator degrades to all.
advanced_en.intervention: CaptionDataset._process_caption → _process_caption_scoped; the Anima cache path only aligns shuffle scope (no runtime tag dropout).
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Trigger words and composition prefixes stay stable while feature/clothing tags can still be regularized.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Targeted tag dropout still scans the whole list; whole-sentence caption_dropout can still blank the caption. Anima multi_copy only produces sequential variants and does not add the full tag-dropout stack on the cache path.
